newsitem.title: USA: Neostar defaults on DIP terms, in talks.
newsitem.headline: Neostar defaults on DIP terms, in talks.

text.p: NeoStar Retail Group Inc said on Tuesday that a shortfall in credit from its suppliers had caused it to default under the terms of its $70 million debtor-in-possession financing, which was approved last month.
Because of the shortfall, the company said it cannot ensure adequate inventory for the holiday sales season.
It said it is talking to lenders about the default.
NeoStar, the parent company of Babbage's and Software Etc, filed a volutary petition in September to reorganize under Chapter 11.

It is also talking to Leonard Riggio, a director and stockholder, about possible financial support such as a subordinated debtor-in-possession financing or a credit enhancement arrangement, the company said.
Riggio is talking to DIP lenders and major vendors but there is no assurance a financing deal can be achieved, the company said.
